Tennessee: what's on the November 3, 2026 ballot

Every candidate below is listed alphabetically, with party shown as text only. Open a name for their stated positions, background and recent news, each with sources.

Open Tennessee on the map

Key dates

  • Voter registration deadline: October 5, 2026. This deadline has passed.
  • Early in-person voting: October 14, 2026 to October 29, 2026. Hours and locations vary by county. Check with your county election commission.
  • Last day to request an absentee (mail) ballot: October 24, 2026. Your county election commission must receive the request by Saturday, October 24. Tennessee voters must meet an eligibility reason to vote absentee.
  • Election Day: November 3, 2026. Polling hours are set by each county. Polls close at 7 p.m. Central or 8 p.m. Eastern. Check your county election commission for opening times.

Official election information: Tennessee Secretary of State – Elections

Who's running

Only the U.S. Senate and governor races are loaded so far. Other statewide offices, ballot measures, U.S. House and local races aren't loaded yet. Check your sample ballot for the full list.

Federal

United States Senate

Voters elect one U.S. senator for a six-year term. Incumbent Republican Bill Hagerty is running for a second term.

State

Governor

Voters elect a governor for a four-year term. This is an open seat because Gov. Bill Lee is term-limited. Tennessee does not elect a lieutenant governor.

Some independent candidates' names may be printed slightly differently on the ballot. Check your sample ballot.
